description: This class named RenameComponents provides functionality to rename components in source files within a specified directory, based on a replacement request file. It reads a list of string replacements and applies these to multiple source files, modifying lines accordingly.

classes.name: RenameComponents
classes.description: A utility class for batch renaming components within Java source files based on a user-provided replacement mapping.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that processes command-line arguments, reads the replace request file, and processes each source file in the specified directory.

methods.name: processFile
methods.description: Reads a source file, applies renaming rules line by line, and writes the output to a new file in the destination directory.

methods.name: processLine
methods.description: Applies all replacement rules to a single line of source code.

methods.name: processLine (overloaded)
methods.description: Replaces specific substrings in a line, used internally by the main line processing method.

methods.name: readReplaceRequest
methods.description: Reads the replace requests from a file, populates the replacement map, and checks for conflicts.

methods.name: assertFolder
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists and is a directory; throws an exception if not.
